title: Explosives
html:
Explosives are a kind of rapidly combustible consumables in Baldur's Gate 3.

“
Hah! Enough warriors to make this a fair fight. Failing that, we've got the means to make it unfair. That's why our every ounce of anything that goes boom is buried out in front of that gate.
„
— Asharak, on the virtues of strategically placed munitions

Overview

Explosives cause one or more of the following effects:

  • ⁠Fire Area of Effect (AOE) damage
  • ⁠Force AoE damage
  • Forcible displacement (knockback) of creatures.

The listings provided below should be seen as non-exhaustive. For details about some saving throw effects, see CanAreaDamageEvade (spell flag).
